column1: # main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# The provisional 64 MB is below what this game's modules actually occupy, so nninitStartup asked for pool − 64 MB of heap (0xc9400000),
# nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize was refused with ResultLimitReached and the game does not retry: it handed StandardAllocator::Initialize a base from
# an unwritten out parameter and crashed at sdk+0xbf430 (write to 0x2000). The host's own line names the footprint:
# "[mem] SetHeapSize 0xc9400000 + modules 0x5e00000 > app pool 0xcd500000" → used memory reported here is 0x5e00000, so the game asks for
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# The game selects near-zero NVN depth at run time (the packaged run's own line: "this run needs … depth near=0"), so the offline
# pipeline archive must be built with main0_z vertex entries; without the key it was made for near=-w and matched none of the run's bases.

column2: Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition shaders
